Political Science
Department of Political Science
About the Department
The Political Science Department at Tyagbir Hem Baruah College is a dynamic and engaging academic department that offers a comprehensive education in political science. The faculty members of the Political Science Department are highly qualified and experienced in their fields. They are passionate about political science and are committed to providing students with a stimulating and supportive learning environment. Faculty members are actively engaged in research, ensuring that their teaching is informed by the latest developments in the field. Students are exposed to various theories and approaches to the study of politics, as well as to empirical research methods. The department also offers courses that focus on specific areas of political science, such as international relations, comparative politics, and political theory. The department also organizes various extracurricular activities and events, such as seminars, workshops, and conferences, which provide students with opportunities to interact with scholars and experts in the field of political science.

Vision
The department aims to cultivate a deep understanding of political systems, theories, and practices, empowering students to analyze and address complex political issues.The department also seeks to instill values of integrity, social justice, and ethical leadership, preparing students to engage meaningfully in civic life and contribute positively to society.
Mission
The mission of the Political Science Department at Tyagbir Hem Baruah College is to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of political systems, theories, and practices. The department aims to cultivate critical thinking, analytical skills, and a deep appreciation for political issues and processes. It seeks to prepare students for careers in government, international relations, academia, and other fields where an understanding of politics is essential. The department is committed to fostering a culture of intellectual curiosity, research excellence, and civic engagement among its students, empowering them to become informed and active participants in the political process.
